summary: Wrote a 5-phase, 4.75-hour implementation plan for the choice-free state-set route. One new leaf module (Independence/TranslationStateSet.lean) carries two layers: an absolutely choice-free ShiftSet avatar of the translation flow over an arbitrary duration group, and the same (H1)/(H2) discharge plus three corollaries at translationFrame D with an explicitly relative pin. TaskFrame.limit_of_shift is untouched per the settled prior decision, so no pinned axiom baseline moves.
